records.description: Unlike traditional revision planners, RevTracky tracks what students actually do, not just what they plan. Features like timers, streaks, and progress insights provide a clear view of effort over time. Light gamification, including coins and leaderboards, adds motivation without distraction, while keeping the experience simple, structured, and easy to use.

records.name: Alignear
records.tagline: The stakeholder communication layer for Linear
records.description: Your Linear workspace is built for your team — not your clients. Alignear translates your progress into professional, client-friendly reports that stakeholders actually understand. No jargon, no raw ticket dumps, no manual write-ups. A secure client portal, automatic cycle & custom reports, and an AI agent that lives inside Linear. Alignear is the client communication layer for Linear teams — keeping stakeholders informed and confident without pulling your team out of their flow.

records.name: React Email 6.0
records.tagline: An open-source email editor you can embed in your own app
records.description: React Email 6.0 introduces an open-source visual editor you can embed in your app with a few lines of code. It outputs email-ready HTML that renders across every major inbox. Fully themeable and extensible. Built in two layers: - a core that works out of the box - a composable Extensions API for custom blocks. Also shipping: new auth and e-commerce templates and a unified package (import everything from react-email).

records.name: Aria
records.tagline: AI-powered call performance intelligence layer
records.description: Aria is a pay-per-call outcome intelligence platform built for teams tired of fragmented data and manual reporting. Unlike traditional call platforms, Aria unifies call data across sources, uses AI to analyze quality and outcomes, and delivers real-time CPA, conversion rates, and ROI by source. No migration required. Just plug in and get instant performance intelligence.

records.name: NODUS AI
records.tagline: Never lose AI answers again.
records.description: If you use AI daily, you’ve probably felt this: You get useful answers… and then lose them inside long conversations. NODUS fixes that. → Save answers instantly with one click → Works across the 7 major AI chat platforms — ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, Copilot, Grok and DeepSeek. → Use Quick Save or organize later → Reuse your ideas anytime No accounts. Local-first. No friction. Stop losing what matters. 👉 I’m offering a limited early lifetime deal ($49) for the first users.

records.name: PeKG
records.tagline: AI memory for coding agent: your knowledge, always available
records.description: AI coding agents have amnesia. They solve the same bugs repeatedly, forgetting hard-won knowledge the moment the session ends. PeKG is a cross-project knowledge graph that agents query via MCP. No prompts to write — the agent captures decisions, patterns, and gotchas as you work, compiles them into searchable wiki articles, and surfaces relevant blockers before you hit them again. BYOLLM: Your agent does the synthesis. PeKG owns the graph. You keep control of your data and tokens.

records.name: ClankerPass
records.tagline: Can you convince an AI that you're an AI?
records.description: GATEKEEPER-9000 is a supremely smug AI that won't let you in unless you can prove you're a fellow machine. You get exactly 3 messages. Pass and you get an official "Clanker Pass" certificate where you can say "Clanker" freely and without repercussion. Fail and it tells you to insert more quarters. It's free, no login, built with Next.js + Mistral. Takes 2 minutes to play and about 5 to fully embarrass yourself.

records.name: ChurnAlert
records.tagline: Know which customers are about to churn before they do
records.description: ChurnAlert gives indie founders a simple churn early warning system. Connect Stripe in 30 seconds and it automatically scores every customer 0 to 100 based on 8 risk signals: inactivity, payment failures, cancellation intent, usage dropoff, and more. Every Monday morning you get a ranked digest in your inbox showing who's at risk and how much MRR is on the line, so you can reach out before they cancel. Built by a solo dev who was tired of finding out about churn after it was already too late.

records.name: Noon Labs — Energy Intelligence
records.tagline: Free energy cost calculator for Australian homes & SMEs
records.description: Noon Labs is a free calculator that estimates your energy costs based on your home size, appliances, business type, and operating hours. It gives Australian homeowners and small business owners an idea of their electricity bill for their situation, then benchmarks it against Australian state averages. Free to use, no signup required. The premium version (coming soon) provides a detailed energy system audit and consultation for businesses wanting to actively reduce costs.

records.name: TestiPull
records.tagline: Collect client testimonials with a link, embed anywhere

Unlike chat threads or solo recommendation apps, Hayya is designed for shared decisions, not individual browsing.
